g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud PCI DSS payments with Apigee, private GKE, Cloud HSM tokenisation and Spanner

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: A merchant's checkout posts a payment to the global external load balancer
Cloud Armor filters it and Apigee checks the merchant's key, quota and schema
Apigee reaches the cardholder data environment through Private Service Connect
An internal load balancer sends it to the payment pods on a private GKE cluster
The pods swap the card number for a token, encrypting it in the vault with a Cloud HSM key
and send the authorisation to the card networks through Cloud NAT
They record the transaction in Spanner and publish the capture to Pub/Sub
At cut-off a Cloud Run job reads the day's captures and writes the settlement file to a locked audit bucket
and sends it to the acquirer through Cloud NAT
